title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
abstract: arXiv:2610.18773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: System one models enable direct, low-latency decision-making. Yet recent practice of predicting an answer from serialized text does not, by itself, respect the structure of a decision problem. We argue that current designs underemphasize four important structural requirements. (i) null-aware: Models should distinguish answer absence from uncertainty among candidates; (ii) permutation-invariant: Reordering alternatives should not change the decision; (iii) option-scalable: Growing candidate sets should not require redefining the output space; (iv) cacheable: Request-independent computation over recurring alternatives should be reusable across requests. We introduce Jeva, a decision-native architecture that addresses these requirements jointly. translated_title: Jeva：从第一性原理出发构建的系统一模型
translated_abstract: 系统一模型能够实现直接、低延迟的决策。然而，近来从序列化文本中预测答案的做法本身并未遵循决策问题的内在结构。我们认为当前设计低估了四个重要的结构性要求：（i）无值感知：模型应能区分“无答案”与候选选项之间的不确定性；（ii）置换不变性：重新排列选项顺序不应改变决策结果；（iii）选项可扩展性：候选集的扩大不应需要重新定义输出空间；（iv）可缓存性：针对重复出现选项的、与请求无关的计算应当可以跨请求复用。我们提出Jeva，一种决策原生的架构，能够共同满足上述要求。该架构采用一个共享编码器独立地表示请求和每个选项，同时一个紧凑的决策堆栈仅针对不可变的选项记忆对请求状态进行细化。对称聚合产生每个（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Jeva提出一种决策原生的系统一模型架构，通过共享编码器独立表示请求与选项、紧凑决策堆栈针对不可变选项记忆细化请求状态，从而共同满足无值感知、置换不变性、选项可扩展性和可缓存性四个结构性要求。
en_tdlr: Jeva is a decision-native System One architecture that jointly satisfies four structural requirements—null-awareness, permutation invariance, option scalability, and cacheability—via a shared encoder that independently represents requests and options, and a compact decision stack that refines the request state against immutable option memory.
